item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyas pa nor gyi sgrub pa 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs
item.coloph: de ltar rig 'dzin stong rgyung mthu chen gyi/ sgrub thabs zad med rgya mtsho gting zab las/ 'gro kun dbul 'phong gi sdug bsngal sel cing / zad med gter gyi dngos grub thob pa'i phyir du/ nor sgrab 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ me gsas rnam rol gar dbang bdud 'dul rtsal dang / snying gi grogs po dge rgan shes rab phun tshogs gnyis gyis yang nas yang du bskul ba la bstan (brten) nas/ snyigs dus kyi skabs su bab pa'i tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ba'i ming ni/ g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis lha ldan rgyal khab su (tu) yi ger btab cing spel zhing brgyud pa'o/ 'di bris nyes tshogs 'gal ba'i rigs gyur tshe/ mkhyen ldan rig 'dzin chen po'i spyan sngar bshags/ dam tshig stang 'dzin legs nyes bya ra mkhan/ dam can bon skyong srung mas grogs gyis shig ci 'dod longs spyod dngos grub ster ba'i bdag gnod sbyin nor lha dpal dang mgon pos skyongs/ 'gro kun dbul 'phong du khas gdung ba rnams/ zad med gter la rgyun du spyod par shog srid mtshor gdung ba'i 'gro ba/ ma gyur nam mkha' khyab tshad/ bde chen bon sku'i zhing du/ gnyis med mnyam par gyur cig/
